matrix.control: Primary provider connection / provider selection
matrix.label: Providers
matrix.native_method_filekey: Desktop REST GET /api/providers/oauth, /api/env, /api/model/options; config.yaml model.provider; native JSON-RPC config.get(provider)
matrix.actual_supportedmodel_accountlimits: Desktop provider catalog and OAuth/API-key eligibility are dynamic per installed provider/account. Jarvis allows provider hint openai-codex or unknown only; only Codex credential presence is projected; auth/access is not proved.
matrix.existingJarvisroute: GET /chat/api/settings; GET /chat/api/conversations/{id}/model-settings (Codex status only)
matrix.missingnativebackend: No provider connect/disconnect, provider selection or provider credential operation in Jarvis; provider read is a tiny sanitized projection.
matrix.danger_secretmasked: API/OAuth credentials never returned; browser stores no credential; setup URI/code flow not yet exposed.
matrix.restart_semantics: Provider auth/config activation is backend-specific; needs per-provider readback and runtime proof.

matrix.control: API keys, OAuth connect/disconnect, account status
matrix.label: Keys / OAuth
matrix.native_method_filekey: Desktop REST /api/env and /api/providers/oauth/*; provider secret files/pool implementations in hermes_cli/auth.py; core currently uses config.get provider for sanitized state
matrix.actual_supportedmodel_accountlimits: Actual provider/account entitlements vary. Presence alone is not authenticated access. Jarvis only detects whether Codex credential is configured; Spark entitlement remains unverified.
matrix.existingJarvisroute: GET /chat/api/settings; model settings snapshot has codexCredential status
matrix.missingnativebackend: No credential CRUD, OAuth workflow, billing/account entitlement, or provider-policy adapter.
matrix.danger_secretmasked: Must remain masked and out of JSON, logs, argv, screenshots and shared config. Desktop secret fields are separate from ordinary config.
matrix.restart_semantics: Provider-specific; reconnection/restart may be required.

matrix.control: Profile default provider/model, context length, model catalog/visibility/favorites
matrix.label: Models
matrix.native_method_filekey: config.yaml model.{provider,default,context_length}; REST /api/model/info, /api/model/options; JSON-RPC config.get(provider), config.set(key=model) supports fixed session mutation in current Jarvis adapter
matrix.actual_supportedmodel_accountlimits: Desktop dynamically lists authenticated provider models. Current Jarvis selector is Codex-only: 8 selectable IDs (gpt-6-sol, gpt-6-luna, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.5, gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5.4); gpt-5.3-codex-spark is visible but disabled until account entitlement is verified.
matrix.existingJarvisroute: Model routes above permit session-only choice; GET /chat/api/settings shows provider/model labels.
matrix.missingnativebackend: No profile default mutation, provider catalog discovery, visibility/favorite controls, or non-Codex selection. Generic config.set must not be surfaced as a browser-controlled key/value API.
matrix.danger_secretmasked: Model names are non-secret but can reveal account/provider; only allowlisted sanitized IDs. Never expose config dumps.
matrix.restart_semantics: Jarvis model selection applies only to the selected resumed conversation; state may be selected-for-session, deferred-next-turn, confirmation-required or unknown-pending. Does not alter profile default.

matrix.control: Reasoning effort/service tier; fallback models; auxiliary tasks and MoA model settings

matrix.actual_supportedmodel_accountlimits: Values are provider/model-specific; Desktop schema/catalog supplies options. Jarvis model catalog only establishes the eight Codex model IDs, not reasoning/service-tier entitlements.

matrix.missingnativebackend: No fixed read/write adapters, per-model option validation, or account capability projection.
matrix.danger_secretmasked: Configuration labels only; avoid model-internal reasoning content. Provider limits must be observed and labeled.
matrix.restart_semantics: Per-config-field and backend; native schema/handler must define. Not established for Jarvis.

matrix.control: Custom endpoints and local model runtime/catalog/download/install/activate

interpretation.native_api_boundary: Desktop REST is the official local UI/backend contract, but it is not the nativeCore Gateway JSON-RPC contract. At this pinned revision the Installer core client allowlist includes session.*, config.get, narrowly used config.set, profiles.list, cron.manage, plugins.list, mcp.servers.status, file.attach, tools.list, skills.manage. Generic config.set is not an authorized public route.
interpretation.readiness: Installed, configured, authenticated, account-entitled, connected, loaded, operational, enabled and target-verified are distinct states. A setting/control should remain pending or unavailable until its source-specific evidence exists.
interpretation.scope: Grouped rows preserve unique functional controls; each `control` field enumerates the controls covered by that group. Desktop-only OS/Electron features have no browser equivalent unless a real browser standard/capability is identified.
